article.headline: Seton Hall tops Wisconsin 74-69 at Baha Mar, will play N.C. State in championship game
article.description: — Trey Parker came off the bench to score 21 points and lead Seton Hall to a 74-69 victory over Wisconsin on Thursday night at the Baha Mar Championship.
article.linkText: Seton Hall tops Wisconsin 74-69 at Baha Mar, will play N.C. State in championship game
article.story: NASSAU, Bahamas -- — Trey Parker came off the bench to score 21 points and lead Seton Hall to a 74-69 victory over Wisconsin on Thursday night at the Baha Mar Championship. Seton Hall (4-1) plays N.C. State for the championship on Friday. Wisconsin (4-1) plays Murray State in the consolation finals. Parker made 7 of 8 shots with two 3-pointers and 5 of 6 free throws. His 3-pointer with 5:10 remaining gave the Pirates the lead for good. Parker added five rebounds and three steals. Reserve Terry Copeland Jr. scored 12 for Seton Hall, while Elijah Fisher and Simeon Wilcher both scored 10. Austin Rapp totaled 18 points and six rebounds off the bench for the Badgers. Braeden Carrington added 17 points and reserve Will Garlock scored 11. Fisher and Wilcher sank 3-pointers and in a game-opening 10-5 run for Seton Hall and Del Jones hit a jumper to extend the lead to 23-8 with 11 minutes remaining. Copeland led Seton Hall with seven points in the first half, and nine different Pirates scored in building a 40-23 advantage. Garlock dunked to cap a 10-0 run to start the second half and Wisconsin cut its deficit to seven. Rapp's 3-pointer with 10:25 remaining got the Badgers within 52-51 and Zach Kinziger's layup tied it 55-all. Copeland and Garlock traded three-point plays to keep it tied, but Parker followed with his go-ahead 3-pointer and the Pirates never trailed again. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
